scores.tell: Cauldron is swollen and pillowy; legs are fat stubby cylinders, handles are chunky rings, rim is a thick soft torus.
Binocular head is a toy-like blob with oversized round eyes; the post and base are fat and soft. Handle crank is a thick sausage.
The table slab and stools are soft, rounded and chunky. Flat faces are mostly kept, but the corners are fat bevels and the pedestal is swollen.
Helmet is a clean rounded dome, which suits the object. Visor is slightly oversized and the base ring is soft.
Whole backpack is puffy like a pillow: pockets, flap and body have no planar faces, corners are blobs, and straps and buckles are thick.
Arched door has planar panels, crisp frame and tight corners; thin hinges, handle and vines stay thin. Wreath and bow are slightly large.
Keyboard has flat planar faces, straight runs, thin stand legs and tight bevels. Only a slightly rounded body edge.
Cooler body and lid are soft and rounded, and the handle is thick. Proportions and part count are right.
Drum rims and hardware are fat and rounded. Stand legs are a bit thick, but all the parts are present and the silhouette reads well.
